meta.title: 形式签名命题保真度人工抽验
meta.purpose: 区分「命题从一开始就写歪/空洞」与「模型证不出」；门A 只判可陈述（能不能编译），不判语义保真。
meta.dedup: 按 (qid, formal_sig 文本 md5) 去重，保留最早 run

layers.L1/PRODUCTION: 20261105 三轮真实运行，全量 10 条
layers.L2/EARLY: 历史样本按时间序前半，8 条，同题≤2
layers.L2/LATE: 历史样本按时间序后半，8 条，同题≤2

meta.blind: 清单不含 stage / tool_verdict / correct / run / 来源文件；答案表单独存放，抽验完成后方可对照，防锚定。

rubric.A: 忠实 — 签名准确表达该子目标，量词/类型/常数/定义域与原题一致
rubric.B: 命题写歪 — 改了题意：量词方向、变量域、常数、把待证结论写成假设、求解题改证明/反证、拆成分类证明
rubric.C: 空洞/平凡 — 恒真或前提矛盾：True、A=A、假设直接蕴含结论、ℕ 减法/除法造成的假等式
rubric.D: 信息不足 — 题目或签名残缺，无法判定

rules: := by sorry 是分工设计（E30），不因出现 sorry 判 B/C
只判「这条签名是否忠于这个子目标 + 原题」，不判能不能证出来
B/C 必须在备注里写出具体错在哪一处
未抽验完毕不得下结论；不作统计推断、不作效果量
meta.source_note: 真实数据只在服务器 results/*.jsonl + <run>/q<id>/0X_*.json；本地 results/ 为 9 月旧数据，未使用。

blind.question:
Find number of triples $(x,y,z)$ of real numbers satisfying
\[
x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = xy^3 + yz^3 + zx^3 = 3.
\]

Remember to put your final answer within \boxed{}.
blind.goal: 分析三变量互不相等时方程组是否有解：利用对称性与不等式估计，证明不存在三互异实数满足条件
blind.description: 分析三变量互不相等时方程组是否有解：利用对称性与不等式估计，证明不存在三互异实数满足条件
blind.expected_output: 证明三变量互不相等时无解
blind.formal_sig: example : ¬ ∃ (x y z : ℝ), x ≠ y ∧ y ≠ z ∧ z ≠ x ∧ x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 3 ∧ x*y^3 + y*z^3 + z*x^3 = 3 := by sorry

blind.question:
Find the maximum value of $D$ satisfying the following condition: There exists an infinite sequence $x_1, x_2, \ldots$ where each term belongs to $[0, 777]$ such that for all positive integers $m < n$, we have $$(m+n)|x_n^2 - x_m^2| \ge D.$$

Remember to put your final answer within \boxed{}.

blind.formal_sig: example (D : ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) (hx : ∀ m n, m < n → (m + n) * |x n ^ 2 - x m ^ 2| ≥ D) (hbound : ∀ n, 0 ≤ x n ∧ x n ≤ 777) : x 1 = 0 := by sorry

blind.question:

blind.question:
Find the minimal $d$ satisfying the following property:

For any sequence of integers $x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n$ satisfying
\[
    0 \le x_i \le 100, \quad \sum_{i=1}^n x_i \ge 1810
\]
for all $i = 1, 2, \ldots, n$, there exists a subset $I$ of $\{1,2, \ldots, n\}$ such that
\[
    \left| \sum_{i \in I} x_i - 1810 \right| \le d.
\]
Remember to put your final answer within \boxed{}.
blind.description: 由 n1b 得到的候选 d=50，证明对任意满足条件的序列都存在子集 I 使得 |sum_I - 1810| ≤ 50
blind.formal_sig: example : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℕ), (∀ i, x i ≤ 100) → (∑ i in Finset.range n, x i) ≥ 1810 → ∃ (I : Finset ℕ), |(∑ i in I, x i) - 1810| ≤ 50 := by sorry

blind.question:
(10 分) 设 $\Omega$ 为开区域. 算子 $Lu := \sum_{i,j=1}^n \partial_i (a_{ij} \partial_j u) + \sum_{j=1}^n b_j \partial_j u + cu$, 定义域为 $C_0^\infty(\Omega)$. 其中 $a_{ij}, b_j, c$ 为实有界光滑函数.

求 $L$ 在 $L^2(\Omega)$ 上的伴随算子 $L^*$.
Remember to put your final answer within \boxed{}.
blind.description: 对二阶项 $\int_\Omega \partial_i(a_{ij}\partial_j u) v \,dx$ 应用分部积分，把两个导数从 $u$ 转移到 $v$
blind.expected_output: 二阶项转移后的积分表达式 $\int_\Omega u \left(-\sum_{i,j} \partial_i(a_{ij} \partial_j v)\right) dx$（边界项已因 $u,v \in C_0^\infty$ 消失）
blind.formal_sig: example (u v : C₀^∞(Ω)) (a : ℝ) : ∫ x in Ω, (∂ i (a * ∂ j u)) * v = -∫ x in Ω, (a * ∂ j u) * (∂ i v) := by sorry

blind.question:
Consider a checkerboard consisting of $38$ by $38$ unit squares. At the midpoints of some of these unit squares, there is an ant. At time 0, each ant starts moving with speed 1 parallel to some edge of the checkerboard. When two ants moving in opposite directions meet, they both turn $90^{\circ}$ clockwise and continue moving with speed 1. When more than two ants meet, or when two ants moving in perpendicular directions meet, the ants continue moving in the same direction as before they met. When an ant reaches one of the edges of the checkerboard, it falls off and will not re-appear.  Also, there are some spiders on the checkerboard that do not move at all.

Considering all possible starting positions, determine the latest possible moment at which the last ant falls off the checkerboard or prove that such a moment does not necessarily exist.
Remember to put your final answer within \boxed{}.
blind.description: 由 n1 的最大距离，分析两只蚂蚁相向相遇转向90度后的路径变化
blind.expected_output: 转向操作不会使蚂蚁总路径长度超过 n1 上界的证明
blind.formal_sig: example (d : ℝ) (h : d ≤ 38) : d + 90_turn_extension ≤ 38 := by sorry
